messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Integer-programming or SAT encoding that exhaustively rules out configurations above a threshold area

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A SAT encoding in which each point is discretized to a 1000x1000 grid can exhaustively prove no configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieves a minimum triangle area exceeding 0.00247, by using cardinality constraints to declare that no three points may form a triangle of area less than this threshold and showing the formula is unsatisfiable. The encoding leverages the fact that the area determinant is integer-valued on this grid, so each forbidden triple maps to a simple clause ruling out that exact coordinate combination. This approach proves the upper bound without continuous reasoning, reducing the geometric problem to pure combinatorial search."}
